notes.title: Update notes for March 1
notes.content: Steam version now inherits the changes made for the console versions. Fixed a variety of quality of life bugs and the loading issue that was preventing some players from starting a new game. Enjoy!

notes.title: Update Notes for v.1.10.19833
notes.content:
Welcome to a new EPIC Adventure!
This update contains bug fixes and performance improvements. Awesome! Go be creative.

notes.title: Update Notes for 1.10.19821
notes.content:
Fixed an issue with blue mushrooms
Added detailed error messaging for server connections

notes.title: Release Notes
notes.content:
Updates to some localization.
Some load bugs were also fixed with this release.

notes.title: Release Notes
notes.content:
Hotfix
A bug preventing torches in 1x2 being lit to unlock the Chest has been fixed.

notes.title: Update Notes for 1.8.19551
notes.content:
New in Update
New Art for the upcoming Anniversary Event
Testing a new feature to allow respawning in Boss Stages for some players
Fixes for Level 1x2 Cinematics
Fixes for the Level 1x3 Boss Fight
Fixed several quest bugs
Small localization tweaks

notes.title: Update Notes for 1.8.19469
notes.content:
New Save system that remembers your progress in levels. Sleep or exit the game without worry and restore back into the level you left during your last session.
New in game decoration art
Localization Fixes
Quest completion fixes
Fixed a Pathing issue in 1x1
Fixed an error on skipping cutscenes

notes.title: Update Notes for 1.7.19205
notes.content:
New Feature: Using Pages to Unlock Levels! - Brand new feature being rolled out is the ability for players to use their collected pages to unlock levels in the game. Pages are dropped randomly from monsters or puzzles.
Bugs and Fixes
Fixed an Ads Issue
Fixed a Loading issue at start of game
Fixed a Quest being still active after the event.
